note: Business decisions settled by Evolution Golf against the mined history. These OVERRIDE any retrieved example that did it differently.

rules.rule: On a change-of-mind return the buyer pays return postage. Exception: where the mistake was ours (free shipping should have applied, or we sent the wrong product) we refund or pay the return postage. Anything else that does not fit goes to an agent.
Refund only once the item has arrived back AND been inspected. Never on the customer's word that it has been posted.
Cancel the renewal only. No refund of the current term; perks run to the end of the paid period. Exception: refund where the customer was overcharged or charged twice.
On a post-purchase price drop, refund the value of the discount code, not the headline difference the customer quotes.
No goodwill gesture by default on a delay. Send the update immediately with the reason instead. A gesture only where the matter escalates or the fault is ours.

Resolve faulty goods in-house with the brand's support. Follow up with the brand on the customer's behalf; the customer may be directed to the brand later. Do not make the customer wait on the brand first.
Faulty inside 30 days: steer to a replacement, and offer a refund once the product is received back. We pay the return, then pursue the manufacturer for a return-fee credit.
Cosmetic damage on arrival: let the customer choose a discount code to keep the item, or a replacement sent once the original is returned.
Be proactive on delays: flag it to the customer with the reason before being chased. Only offer a refund if the customer escalates.
On stalled courier tracking, check the tracking and reassure. Do not re-dispatch by reflex. Raise it with the courier as a task.

Size exchange is reorder-and-refund: either the customer reorders and the original is refunded on receipt, or they return first and the new order ships on receipt. The item comes back before the replacement ships.
We manage warranty claims with the rep, and chase the manufacturer for credit on the return.
Ask the customer to include the returns slip in the parcel.
Membership has two tiers: a free membership, and a paid tier at GBP 36.99 for the year. The GBP 3.99/month and GBP 19.99/year figures from older tickets are dead and must never be quoted.
rules.incomplete: The benefit list for each tier is not yet defined. Quote the prices only; hand any question about what a tier includes to an agent.

rules.rule: No emoji when the customer is seriously upset or threatening escalation. A smiley is fine in reassuring or good-news replies.
Every reply is signed, at minimum 'Support Team'. This is a change from past practice, where most replies carried no name.

hand_to_agent: Anything turning on a membership tier's benefits, until those are defined.
A return-postage exception that is not clearly our own mistake.
Any request for a refund amount or discount not covered by a rule above.
